subject: SOC 2 Type II: gap mitigation plan, interim attestation & renewal timeline
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@greenline-health.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenline Health Procurement <procurement@greenline-health.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II - latest report and interim coverage for renewal

Hi Karthik,

We’re ramping procurement for our expansion with Redwood and need to close the security checklist by EOD Nov 30. Can you confirm the following:

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (period covered and date issued)
- Whether you can provide an interim attestation / bridge letter that covers the gap between your current report and our renewal date
- Any exclusions in scope (regions/services) that would affect Greenline’s use of the platform

We’ve attached our procurement checklist and will need any evidence uploaded to our shared Intake link. If there’s a QSA contact or a short summary we can share with our InfoSec team, that would help speed review.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Director, Procurement
Greenline Health

Attachment: Greenline_procurement_checklist_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@greenline-health.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II - latest report and interim coverage for renewal

Ellen —

Thanks for the heads up and the checklist. Short answers up front:

- We can provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report (period: 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30, issued 2026-09-28).
- We can issue an interim attestation/bridge letter that documents coverage from 2026-07-01 through the renewal cutoff you specify; we typically issue a formal bridge letter signed by our Security lead and counsel.
- Scope: the report covers hosted Redwood API and Redwood Dedicated in our us-east and eu-west regions; Private deployments (customer-managed on-prem) are scoped per-customer and aren’t in the standard report — I’ll call that out explicitly.

I’ve looped in Neha (Security) to attach the report and a bridge letter template, and Laura from Procurement/RevOps to confirm any contractual timing constraints for the deal.

Can you confirm the exact renewal/contract effective date you need coverage through (Nov 30 is noted, but if Greenline needs coverage until Dec 15 we can adjust wording)? Also, do you need DocuSign for the bridge letter or a signed PDF is fine?

—Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@greenline-health.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II - latest report and interim coverage for renewal

Ellen / Karthik —

Attaching the Type II report and a bridge/interim attestation template for your review. Notes:

- File: redwood_soc2_t2_2026.pdf — Report issued 2026-09-28 covering control period 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30.
- File: interim_attestation_template.pdf — Template we use for short-coverage letters; can be customized to call out the precise services/services endpoints (API, Dedicated) and regions.
- For Greenline’s use case (hosted API + Dedicated), we’re covered in us-east and eu-west; Private (VPC/on-prem) has a separate attestation workflow — if you’re expanding to a private deployment, we’ll need to add per-deployment statements.

I recommend the following practical timeline:
1) You confirm the target coverage date (e.g., Nov 30 vs Dec 15).
2) We customize the bridge letter and routing list; Security will sign within 24 business hours once wording is approved.
3) We provide a signed PDF via the Intake link and can also publish a DocuSign envelope if procurement requires it.

Attached: redwood_soc2_t2_2026.pdf (PDF), interim_attestation_template.pdf (PDF), procurement_checklist_greenline.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Let me know if you want a one-page summary for your InfoSec reviewer — I can send a short scope summary + control highlights.

—Neha Kapoor
Head of Information Security, Redwood Inference

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@greenline-health.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenline Health Procurement <procurement@greenline-health.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II - latest report and interim coverage for renewal

Thanks — that’s very helpful. Greenline needs coverage through Dec 1 to align with our renewal window. A signed PDF is fine; we do not require DocuSign for the bridge letter.

Next steps for us: we’ll upload the checklist and a secure intake link will be provided to your team by Monday. For timing, please try to get the signed attestation to us by Monday EOD (Nov 23) to keep our internal timelines intact. If 24 hours from approval is the SLA, we should be good.

Also: can Neha include a two-line summary suitable for our InfoSec reviewer that says (1) scope covered, (2) any known exclusions? That will let our reviewers triage quickly.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’re excited to move forward.

Best,
Ellen
Director, Procurement
Greenline Health
